content.title: Savannah Guthrie's Kids Vale and Charley: Everything to Know
content.text: For Today show co-anchor Savannah Guthrie, family has always come first. The mom-of-two has never been shy about including her loved ones in segments and specials over the years. But on February 1, 2026, her world was turned upside down after her 84-year-old mother—Nancy Guthrie—went missing in Arizona.With home searches, ransom notes, potential suspects and conflicting reports dominating headlines and social media feeds, the Guthrie family—including Savannah's husband Michael Feldman, her sisterAnnie Guthrie and her brother Camron Guthrie—have been forced to navigate this harrowing crisis under a microscope, with millions of people watching their every move.On March 5, Guthrie visited Studio 1A at Rockefeller Center for the first time since her mother's disappearance. "I have every intention of coming back," she told her Today colleagues. "You're my family. And I would like to try."Amid the chaos and heartbreak, one can only imagine the conversations happening at home between Savannah and her two young children—Vale, 11, and Charley, 9. Kids are so perceptive—and with the case dominating the news cycle, their friends and classmates are probably talking about it, too. But for Vale and Charley, this isn't just a headline—their grandmother is missing.Savannah has understandably stepped aside from her professional duties to focus on her family—and undoubtedly been comforted by her two beloved children. In a 2024 guest post on Ann Voskamp's blog, she described her kids as her greatest joy and most searing daily challenge, adding: "Loving them has made my life meaningful."Here is everything Savannah has shared through the years about her pregnancies and raising Vale and Charley.🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬Savannah Guthrie and daughter Vale on Thursday, April 25, 2019Nathan Congleton/NBCU Photo Bank/NBCUniversal(Nathan Congleton/NBCU Photo Bank/NBCUniversal)How many kids does Savannah Guthrie have?Savannah, 54, has two children with husband Michael Feldman: daughter Vale Guthrie Feldman (born August 2014), and son Charles “Charley” Max Guthrie Feldman (born December 2016). Vale and Charley are currently 11 years old and 9 years old, respectively.Guthrie has previously detailed how becoming a mother reaffirmed her Christian faith, writing on Ann Voskamp's blog: "Motherhood. What a revelation. Physically. Emotionally. Intellectually. And yes, spiritually. I can think of no other experience that has more enhanced my understanding of God.""To me, parenthood is God’s ultimate real-life metaphor; it is the closest humans will ever get to grasping how God relates to us," she added. "It is no accident the scriptures refer to him as our heavenly Father, and we, his children—the nearest approximation of God’s love for us is parent to child."Related: A Comprehensive Timeline of Savannah Guthrie’s Marriage and Dating PastHow old was Savannah Guthrie when she had her daughter?Guthrie was 42 years old when she gave birth to her daughter, Vale, on August 13, 2014. She was actually four months pregnant with Vale at her wedding reception.During the pregnancy, Guthrie blogged: “I’m 42 years old, and I honestly didn’t know if I’d ever get this chance. I’ve never been more thankful or felt more blessed from above. I know how lucky I am. For a long time, I think I was afraid to even let myself think about how much I hoped to one day have a baby. So that’s my mindset as my hubby and I embark on this adventure.”Michael Feldman, Charley and Vale support their mom at her Mostly What God Does book release.Jamie McCarthy/Getty Images(Jamie McCarthy/Getty Images)How old was Savannah Guthrie when she had her son?On December 8, 2016, the then-44-year-old Guthrie welcomed her second child, a son named Charles. "Weeks shy of my forty-fifth birthday, my little firecracker Charley wailed his way into the world," Savannah wrote in another guest post on Ann Voskamp's blog. "Our family was complete."Across social media and on Today, Savannah has shared relatable—and often hilarious—stories about raising two young kids, even revealing that Charley and Vale are "so embarrassed" of their famous mom.“My little boy—he’s 8—they’re having ‘May Day’ at school, which is a little event and there’s an afterparty in their second-grade homeroom,” Savannah said during Today with Jenna & Friends on May 20, 2025. “He literally said to me this morning, ‘Mommy, I want you to come to May Day, but I do not want you to come to the afterparty.’”Savannah recounted his reply after she asked why: "He's like, 'It’s gotten around that some people know you work on the news and it’s weird and it’s embarrassing ... We don’t need that attention so, you’re not invited to the afterparty.'" To which she joked, "But I'm bringing the juice boxes!"Did Savannah Guthrie use IVF?Although her first pregnancy occurred naturally at age 42, she conceived Charley via in vitro fertilization (IVF). Following a miscarriage after the birth of her daughter Vale, Savannah underwent two rounds of IVF treatments to get pregnant with her son, whom she calls a "medical miracle."As for making the choice to pursue IVF treatment, Guthrie told Health magazine in a 2019 cover story: “I didn’t want to start a process where we spent all of our present searching after some future … when our present was so lovely and beautiful and enough. But I also knew I would love for Vale to have a sibling—especially because we are older, it was important to me for her to have a sibling, somebody to do life with.”She called Charley "the last egg out," telling the outlet: "We’re so blessed. Going through what we did, it makes you realize that everything has to go just right to have a healthy baby. I really feel for so many women who are struggling and wishing and wondering, ‘When’s it gonna be my turn?’ I know. And I understand.”Related: Savannah Guthrie Did This Surprising Thing While Her Kids Were at Sleep-Away CampSavannah and son Charley on Monday, October 21, 2019Nathan Congleton/NBC/NBCU Photo Bank via Getty Images(Nathan Congleton/NBC/NBCU Photo Bank via Getty Images)Who takes care of Savannah Guthrie's children?Guthrie and husband Michael Feldman reportedly don't employ a nanny to assist with childcare. Instead, they use a "tag-team" approach to get their kids up and out of the house every day, despite the fact that both are working professionals. (Feldman works as a communications and political consultant.)"Mike is chief technology officer and chief grilling officer," Guthrie joked in a 2020 issue of Reveal. "He sets the alarm and gets up early every day to help me get ready for the Today show. And he sets up the kids for Zoom school. Then, about mid-morning, it’s my turn to take over for a little while so he can do his actual job, as founder of a strategic consulting company."What has Savannah Guthrie said about parenting?Although Savannah doesn’t share a ton of personal information about her kids, she has offered tidbits about life as a mom and her approach to parenting. She is serious about limiting her kids’ access to technology, for example, and keeping them safe while doing so.“My daughter got a little personal iCloud address, and I actually drafted a contract for her to sign,” Guthrie said in this August 2025 clip from Today With Jenna & Friends:“It was basically like, ‘I know that mommy and daddy love me more than anything in the world,’” Savannah continued. “‘I know that mommy and daddy can read my texts. I know I wouldn’t put in a text anything I don’t want grandma and grandpa to see [or] that I wouldn’t want to see on the front page of the New York Times.’”For now, Vale only has an iCloud address and not an actual iPhone. Savannah explained that her daughter “knows that I reserve the right to look at her text,” but that she “trusts” her.Next, Savannah Guthrie Sends Emotional Message to ‘Today’ Colleagues at First Studio Visit Since Mom Nancy’s AbductionThis story was originally published by Parade on Mar 6, 2026, where it first appeared in the Celebs section.
